title: ligularia hodgsonii var. crenifera
intro: Ligularia hodgsonii var. crenifera, commonly known as the Golden Ray, is a plant species native to the Himalayan region, characterized by its bright yellow flowers and large, ovate leaves. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in relieving pain, reducing fever, and treating infections. The therapeutic actions of Ligularia hodgsonii var. crenifera include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic effects, making it a valuable resource for treating various ailments. Bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpenoids and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
